questionText: The conversion of raw materials into finished products creates
explanation: Converting raw materials into finished products changes their form, thereby creating form utility.

questionText: Commerce makes it possible for man to live in a
explanation: Commerce enables specialization, trade, and interdependence, allowing people to live in a complex and organized society.

questionText:
Aboki Plc became insolvent and decided to wind up to meet the legitimate claims of its creditors. Babalawee was called in to manage the dissolution.

After paying the debts of Aboki Plc, the balance goes to
explanation: After all debts are paid during liquidation, any remaining balance/assets are distributed to the shareholders as the residual owners of the company.

questionText:
Aboki Plc became insolvent and decided to wind up to meet the legitimate claims of its creditors. Babalawee was called in to manage the dissolution.

Babalawee is a
explanation: Babalawee was appointed to manage the dissolution of the insolvent company, making him a receiver — a person appointed to take charge of a company's assets during insolvency.

questionText: A common requirement for public and private limited companies in Nigeria is that

options.A: a shareholder cannot transfer his shares to some one else without permission from other shareholders
options.B: their annual accounts are made avaible to the corporate affairs commission
options.C: shares can be offrred for sale on the stock exchange
options.D: Shares can be offered for sales through an issuing house.

explanation: Both public and private limited companies are required by law to file their annual accounts with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC).

questionText: The primary motive behind an individual engaging in production is to

options.A: fully engage all the factors of production

explanation: The primary motive of production is to satisfy or meet basic human needs and wants.

questionText: Musa obtains wool from his sheep, spins and transforms it into cloth which he sells to consumers. This is a form of
explanation: Musa is involved in all stages of production — from extracting raw materials (wool), to manufacturing (spinning into cloth), to retailing (selling to consumers). This involvement across multiple stages is vertical integration.

questionText: A company has an authorized capital of 40 million at N1 per share, out of which 32 million shares have been issued and fully paid-up. The remaining 8 million shares have

options.A: been issued but have not been paid up
options.B: been applied for but not issued

explanation: The 8 million shares are part of the authorized capital but remain unissued — they have not yet been offered or allocated to any investor.

questionText:
An abridged version of a company's income statement for 1993 contains the following information:
Turnover: N286.5 million
Cost of goods sold: N147.5 million
Overhead and other expenses: N85.5 million
Taxes due for the year: N26.9 million

What was the company's profit before taxes for 1993?
explanation: Profit before taxes = Turnover - Cost of goods sold - Overhead and other expenses = 286.5 - 147.5 - 85.5 = N53.5 million.

questionText: A business whose owners enjoy loan facilities on the basis of personal goodwill is a
explanation: Community banks operate at the grassroots level where personal relationships and goodwill form the basis for extending loan facilities to business owners.

questionText: Which of the following is not a veritable source of funds to a public limited liability company?

options.D: Funds from the sale of shares.

explanation: Government financial grants are not a regular or veritable source of funds for public limited companies. Bank loans, retained earnings, and share sales are standard sources.

questionText:
N200,000.00 Liverpool, U.K, June 2, 1995
Three months after date, pay to or to the order of Mr. Okon Etim Esin
Two hundred thousand Naira
Payable at First Bank, Plc.
Lagos                          Imo Edit Enoh
No 5 Due Sept., 2 1995        Liverpool.

Okon Etim Esin is the
explanation: Okon Etim Esin is the payee — the person to whom payment is to be made — making him the creditor in this transaction.

questionText:
N200,000.00 Liverpool, U.K, June 2, 1995
Three months after date, pay to or to the order of Mr. Okon Etim Esin
Two hundred thousand Naira
Payable at First Bank, Plc.
Lagos                          Imo Edit Enoh
No 5 Due Sept., 2 1995        Liverpool.

The document represents a
explanation: The document is a bill of exchange — it is a written order by one party (drawer) directing another to pay a specified sum to a named person (payee) at a future date.

questionText: The term 5 Net 7 on an invoice means that

options.A: 5% discount will be allowed on the price charged if payment is made within seven days
options.B: 5% discount will be allowed on the price charged if payment is made after seven days
options.C: 5% surcharge will be made unless payment is made within seven days
options.D: 5% discount will be allowed on the price charged only if the goods are bought within seven days.

explanation: "5 Net 7" means a 5% cash discount will be given if the invoice is paid within 7 days; otherwise the full (net) amount is due.

questionText: Kabir receives two quotations. Ade quotes N100 less 20% trade discount, while Benson quotes N100 less 30% trade discount and 10% cash discount. If Kabir wants to take advantage of trade and cash discount, then

options.A: the materials should be supplied by Ade
options.B: the materials should be supplied by both of them
options.C: the materials should be supplied by Benson
options.D: Benson should be asked to reduce his trade discount.

explanation: Ade's price = N100 - 20% = N80. Benson's price = N100 - 30% = N70, then minus 10% cash discount = N63. Benson offers the lower total cost.

questionText: A company which issues a promissory note in lieu of payment for goods purchased

options.A: can refuse to pay on due date since it is only a promise.
options.B: is bound to redeem the not for cash on due date
options.C: is not bound to renew the note before payment
options.D: can return the goods purchased and refuse to pay.

explanation: A promissory note is a legally binding document. The issuer is obligated to redeem it for cash on the due date as promised.

questionText: Kamaldeen is a seller in a hire-purchase agreement with Emeka. By law, Kamaldeen cannot recover the hire purchased goods. This is an instance of a restriction on

options.A: Emeka's right to terminate the agreement
options.B: Kamaldeen's right to re-hire the goods
options.C: Emeka's right to breach the agreement
options.D: Kamaldeen's right to terminate the agreement.

explanation: Hire purchase law restricts the seller's (Kamaldeen's) right to repossess goods once the buyer has paid a certain proportion of the total price, limiting his right to terminate the agreement.

questionText: The main documents sent to an importer of goods by the exporter are

options.A: invoice, consular invoice, certificate of origin, freight note, indent and insurance policy.
options.B: indent, bill of lading, certificate of origin, invoice and bill of exchange
options.C: certificate of origin, bill of exchange, invoice, insurance policy, indent and bill of lading
options.D: bill of lading, invoice, insurance policy, consular invoice, certificate of origin and bill of exchange.

explanation: The standard set of documents sent by an exporter to an importer includes the bill of lading, commercial invoice, insurance policy, consular invoice, certificate of origin, and bill of exchange.

questionText: The document that indicates instant payment of cash for goods whenever they are delivered is
explanation: A proforma invoice is sent in advance and requires cash payment before or upon delivery of goods.

questionText: Which of the following documents permits an importer to inspect his goods before the arrival of the bill of lading?
explanation: A bill of sight allows an importer to inspect and identify goods at the port before the bill of lading arrives, enabling customs clearance.

questionText: The overriding advantage of home trade over foreign trade is
explanation: The most significant advantage of home trade is the ease of payment since the same currency is used, eliminating exchange rate complications.

questionText: A distinction between Comprehensive Insurance and Third Party Insurance is that the latter covers damages

options.D: to the driver of the insured vehicle.

explanation: Third party insurance only covers damages caused by the insured vehicle to other people and their property, unlike comprehensive insurance which also covers the insured vehicle itself.

questionText: The rate at which a central bank discounts first class bills is called the
explanation: The bank rate (also called the discount rate) is the rate at which the central bank discounts or rediscounts first-class bills of exchange.

questionText: The principle of subrogation states that

options.A: an insured person should be indemnified to the tune of the amount insured
options.B: an insurance company can stand in place of the insured in dealing with third party
options.C: only a person who likely to suffer loss should take out an insurance cover
options.D: there must be a close connection between the actual loss suffered and risk insured.

explanation: Subrogation allows the insurance company, after paying a claim, to step into the shoes of the insured and pursue any third party responsible for the loss.

questionText: Tolu purchased goods from Yemisi and is to pay custom duties before collection. The goods are likely to be collected from
explanation: A bonded warehouse stores imported goods on which customs duties have not yet been paid. The goods are released only after duties are settled.

questionText: The three major functional units which the modern computer has are

options.A: the input, the processor and the output units
options.B: the black box, output and input units.

explanation: Modern computers consist of three major functional units: the input unit (for data entry), the processor (CPU, for processing), and the output unit (for displaying results).

questionText: I foreign investment. II Long-term lending. III Short-term lending. IV Foreign exchange reserve. V Short-term borrowing. Which combination of the above include capital account in international trade?
explanation: The capital account in international trade records long-term capital flows, which include foreign investment (I) and long-term lending (II). Short-term items belong to the current account.

questionText: The elimination of faults in a computer program is called
explanation: Debugging is the process of finding and fixing errors (bugs) in a computer program.

questionText: Aliyu bought 100 shares at the stock market through a stockbroker. He was told the price of each share was N3 cum. div. This means that Aliyu

options.A: is entitled always to a cummulative dividend on the shares
options.B: is entitled to the next dividend accruing from the shares
options.C: will not be entitled to the next dividend due to the shares
options.D: still owes N3 on the shares which will be subtracted from the dividends.

explanation: "Cum div" (cum dividend) means the shares were purchased with the right to receive the next declared dividend.

questionText: The forum for the selling and buying of securities of small and medium companies is called
explanation: The Second Tier Securities Market was established specifically for trading securities of small and medium-sized companies that could not meet the requirements of the main stock exchange.

questionText: A wholesale dealer in securities is known as
explanation: A jobber is a wholesale dealer who buys and sells securities on their own account on the stock exchange floor, dealing only with stockbrokers, not the public.

questionText: Modern business philosophy emphasizes
explanation: Modern business philosophy (the marketing concept) places customer satisfaction at the centre of all business activities.

questionText: The main role of advertising is to

options.B: show the actual shape, form and colour of the products
options.C: inform people where to obtain goods and service.

explanation: The primary role of advertising is to persuade and convince prospective buyers to purchase a product or service.

questionText: The concept of limiting the types, sizes and other characteristics of a product line without sacrificing utility or durability is called
explanation: Simplification involves reducing the variety and range of products to a manageable number without compromising quality or utility.

questionText: The focal point of all marketing efforts is the
explanation: The buyer (consumer) is the focal point of all marketing efforts — all marketing activities revolve around identifying and satisfying consumer needs.

questionText: Adigun displays goods of different makes on shelves in his supermarket. This is an exmple of
explanation: Displaying goods on shelves with price tags is legally an invitation to treat — it invites customers to make an offer to buy, rather than being an offer to sell.

questionText: The process of bringing a company under exclusive state ownership and control is known as
explanation: Nationalization is the process by which the government takes over private businesses and places them under exclusive state ownership and control.

questionText: Q acting as the agent of P, lawfully and reasonably incurs the amount of N350 as expenses. If Q comes to P for payment, this is an instance of P's duty to
explanation: It is the principal's duty to indemnify the agent — to compensate the agent for all lawful expenses reasonably incurred while carrying out the principal's business.

questionText: In a hire purchase agreement between Argungu Ltd and Maikudi, Argungu Ltd inserted the provision that it can enter Maikudi's premises at any time and remove the hired vehicle for any breach. This provision is
explanation: The provision is lawful as it protects the seller's ownership rights under hire purchase law. Until all installments are paid, the seller retains legal ownership and can include repossession clauses for breach.

questionText: In every simple contract, the price which is paid to purchase a promise is called
explanation: Consideration is the value (money, goods, services, or promise) exchanged between parties in a contract — it is the price paid for the promise.

questionText: One major disadvantage of a cartel is that it

options.B: brings the merging firms under control

explanation: The major disadvantage of a cartel is that it eliminates competition, which can lead to higher prices and reduced consumer choice.

questionText: An aspect of the law which allows an exclusive right for a limited number of years is a
explanation: A patent grants the inventor an exclusive right to make, use, and sell their invention for a limited period of years.

questionText: The basis elements of a valid contract are

options.C: offer, acceptance, intention, capacity and legality

explanation: The essential elements of a valid contract include offer, acceptance, intention to create legal relations, capacity of parties, and legality of purpose.

questionText: In an organisation, civic consideration arises from

options.A: its social negative impacts on the community
options.C: the profit derived from the environemnt
options.D: the fact that it is registered in that locality

explanation: Civic consideration arises from a company's operations within its environment — the impact of business activities on the surrounding community.

questionText: The main difference between nationalization and indigenization in terms of
explanation: The main difference is in shareholding — nationalization involves complete government ownership, while indigenization transfers shares/ownership to local citizens.

questionText: After registration, a certificate of trading is usually issued to
explanation: A certificate of trading (business name registration certificate) is issued to partnerships after registration under the Business Names Act.

questionText: A bus driver operating between Lagos and Jos pledged the owner's credit in Benin in order to have the engine repaired and the bill sent to the owner. This is a case of
explanation: Agency by necessity arises when an agent acts without prior authority due to an emergency — the driver had to repair the engine to continue the journey, creating agency by necessity.

questionText: A chamber of commerce is any association made up of
explanation: A chamber of commerce is an association of merchants (businesspeople/traders) in a particular area who come together to promote business interests.

questionText: The first known legislation to protect consumer right in Nigeria is the
explanation: The Food and Drugs Act was the first major legislation enacted in Nigeria specifically aimed at protecting consumer rights by regulating the production and sale of food and drugs.
